#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""usage: python3 confere.py base.md transcript.txt
Is each quoted excerpt in the base found in the transcript? Exits 1 if any is missing."""
import re, sys, unicodedata

def n(s):  # lowercase, no accents, no punctuation
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s.lower()).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9%]+", " ", s)).strip()

base = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
tx = n(open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8").read())
fora = 0
for trecho in re.findall(r'"([^"]{20,})"', base):
    ok = n(trecho) in tx
    fora += not ok
    print("OK  " if ok else "FORA", trecho[:70])
sys.exit(1 if fora else 0)

Timer do systemd no seu usuário (o finvi: A systemd timer under your user (finviral uses it this way). Replace <canal> and the script path.
[Unit]\nDescription=<canal> — diario às:
[Unit]
Description=<canal> — diario às 02:00

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Fri *-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=false

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
[Unit]\nDescription=<canal> — rodada dia:
[Unit]
Description=<canal> — rodada diario
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/bash %h/projetos/<canal>/auto/rodar.sh diario
TimeoutStartSec=10h
MemoryMax=60G
Nice=5
systemctl --user daemon-reload\nsystemct:
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now <canal>-diario.timer
systemctl --user list-timers '<canal>-*'

# skip one round without turning off the schedule
echo "2026-10-17 diario" >> auto/pular.txt
# minuto hora dia mês dia-da-semana com:
# minute hour day month day-of-week  command
0 2 * * 1-5  /bin/bash $HOME/projetos/<canal>/auto/rodar.sh diario
<p>Com <code>Persistent=false</code>, um: With Persistent=false, a missed round (machine off at 02:00) does not run late when the machine comes back. For a daily radar, yesterday's video published in the afternoon is no use.
<p><code>TimeoutStartSec</code> e <code>: TimeoutStartSec and MemoryMax are limits: a round that hangs gets shut down, and one that bloats doesn't take the machine down with it. A round with no limit that hangs at 02:00 is still hanging at 09:00.
